title: [review] provisioning.py:284: Empty peer_host string ac
description: If request.remote.hostinfo returns an empty string, it passes the 'if not peer_host' check (since empty string is falsy... wait no, empty string IS falsy). Actually this is fine - empty string would fail the check. Let me reconsider: create_br_session() and create_node_session() do not validate peer_host, so if called directly with empty string, it would be accepted as a valid session key.
